# checked: 2026-09-05

# The consolidated BACH routing table (Bank / District / Branch / Routing, dated
# 26.06.2025), published by Dhaka Bank PLC — a scheduled bank — on its own site.
# ROUTING NUMBERS ONLY: names and districts are deliberately NOT stored, because
# this file exists to CORROBORATE that a routing we carry is real, never to
# supply a name or a district. Those come from each bank's own site.
#
# Used ADDITIVELY and for corroboration only, per the owner's 2026-09-04
# decision. It is never an authority on ABSENCE: it is a June-2025 snapshot, so a
# branch opened since is legitimately missing from it.
#
# CORRECTION to an earlier note: 205_southeast.txt says this source "omits NCC
# BANK (prefix 160) ENTIRELY". It does not — it carries 138 NCC rows across 62
# prefixes. The rows have an EMPTY bank-name column (the name is printed once per
# block), so a parser keyed on that column misses them; keying on the trailing
# 9-digit routing finds them. The conclusion still stands for other reasons, but
# the stated evidence for it was a parsing artefact.
